upstream.codeText:
// main functions
seqnote = x => t * 2 ** ((x) / 12),
addharmony3 = (ch1, ch2, ch3) => (ch1 % 85) + (ch2 % 85) + (ch3 % 85),
addharmony = (ch1, ch2) => (ch1 % 127) + (ch2 % 127),
reverse = (x, l, d) => x % 256 * (t & l) / d,
decay = (x, l, d) => x % 256 * (-t & l) / d,

T = t,
upstream.author: Greaserpirate
upstream.name: Remix of Two2Fall's beepbox song
upstream.description: Gradually gets more intense, dramatic buildup, converted to slidy mseq(), added a melody, and a spooky surprise.
